chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"There is no saʿy for the one who is riding, but he should increase his speed somewhat."

key_terms.سَعْيٌ: the ritual walking or movement of saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah
key_terms.لِيُسْرِعْ: let him move faster or hasten

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing saʿy while riding between Ṣafā and Marwah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning saʿy between Ṣafā and Marwah when performed while riding. It indicates that the full ruling of saʿy does not apply to the rider in the usual manner, though some slight increase in speed is still to be observed.
